design: One pair per shape; frozen Phase 1 guide + Astra/high versus bounded routed policy. Models/effort change too; no causal attribution to an individual component. Eight native local CLI evaluations, not production qualification.
limitations: No repeated seeds or long engineering tasks; cannot establish broad quota savings.
Token counters are recorded API telemetry, not billable quota conversions.
Exact model turns, complete file-read coverage and semantic retry counts unavailable.
Tool counts include command, MCP and file-change events; exclude notices/reasoning/messages.
Model outputs include serialized MCP results. Test invocations are command-pattern proxies, plus one independent oracle per case.
Native agents disabled in both variants; zeros do not demonstrate coordination savings.
Initial critical-after keyword oracle false negative was corrected from its recorded ambiguous-delivery evidence without rerunning or changing task behavior.
Runner metric extraction was corrected to count MCP output and omit non-tool notices. No additional model run was performed.
